scenes.headline: Where an agent harness spends a task's seconds
scenes.sub: OpenHuman against OpenClaw and Hermes, on the same model
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Poha! A new open source harness says it beats OpenClaw and Hermes on speed. Let's see where the seconds go.

scenes.text: Hold the model fixed, and a harness can only win with fewer calls, cheaper calls, or less time outside the model.
scenes.say: Hold the model fixed, and a harness has three levers. Fewer calls, cheaper calls, or less time spent outside the model.

steps.say: Every call sends the same fixed prefix. The system prompt and the tool schemas.
The model answers with tool calls, and the harness runs them.
OpenHuman squeezes big tool results before the model sees them. That is lossy, so the original goes to a cache.
The results join the history, and the next call carries all of it.

scenes.title: A task's wall time
scenes.text: T = T outside + n x t per call

parts.note: start-up, tools, the harness's own work
parts.say: First, time outside the model. Start-up, running tools, the harness thinking.
Times what each call costs. Reading the prompt, then writing the reply.

scenes.title: Seconds inside model calls, per task
scenes.say: On the six tasks all three solved, the time spent waiting on the model is nearly the same.

scenes.title: Seconds outside model calls, per task
scenes.say: The gap is here. OpenHuman spends barely a second outside the model. The others spend about thirteen and twenty-one, mostly starting up.

steps.say: In the viral email demo, OpenHuman's tool result was compressed, and it summarised from the truncated view.
Hermes parsed every message with a script. The faster agent did less work.

scenes.text: Same model, nearly the same model time. The lead comes from starting quicker and stopping sooner.
scenes.say: Same model, nearly the same model time. The lead comes from starting quicker, and stopping sooner.

recap: A harness can only cut calls, tokens or overhead
Model time was nearly equal across all three
OpenHuman wins on start-up and memory
scenes.say: To recap. Model time was nearly equal. OpenHuman wins on start-up and on memory, and it stops sooner.
